posts.name: Typewise Nova
posts.tagline: AI customer experience that builds and improves itself
posts.description: Nova is the AI Operator that builds and improves your AI customer experience team, no developer required. Describe in plain language how customers should be handled and connect your tools. Nova builds the agents, tests them on past tickets and shows you what failed before anything goes live. Once running, it monitors quality and proposes fixes 24/7 for approval. Agents resolve whole requests, from orders and refunds to plan changes, across email, chat and WhatsApp. Unresolved requests are free.

posts.name: AI Observability by OpenObserve
posts.tagline: OpenTelemetry-native observability for agents and LLMs
posts.description: Your agent cost $40 and took 34 seconds. But why? OpenObserve traces every agent session across models, tools, services, datastores, and user sessions so you can see exactly where time, money, and quality went. Detect loops, run online evals, and follow failures from the LLM call through your backend and database, alongside the logs, traces, and metrics from the rest of your production stack.

posts.name: iPhone Duo
posts.tagline: The largest iPhone display ever. In a thin, foldable design.
posts.description: Introducing iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone. When open, it’s the thinnest iPhone with the largest display ever — 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max. And it has an outer display with more than 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Through reimagined iOS experiences, it offers unparalleled versatility in all-new poses and orientations. All in a durable, pocketable design. It’s an iPhone unlike any iPhone.

posts.name: AirPods 5
posts.tagline: 1.5x Active Noise Cancellation, AI Siri, Live Translation
posts.description: AirPods 5 brings better active noise cancellation to the open-ear design, along with a smarter Siri that can hold real conversations and live translation for talking across languages. Built for calls, workouts, and everyday listening. Available September 18, 2026.

posts.name: Live Captions by Subanana
posts.tagline: Your whole audience follows, in their own language
posts.description: You speak once. Your audience scans a QR code, picks a language, and follows you live on their own phone — reading it, or hearing it. Put two languages on the big screen, or send a clean feed into OBS and vMix.

posts.name: Suno v6
posts.tagline: The first Suno model built with the music industry
posts.description: Suno v6 is a new generation of music models in three flavors: flagship v6, exploratory v6-wild, and free v6-mini. Edit one section or lyric without remaking the track, mash up your own songs, and start from text, audio, images, or video.

posts.name: Desert Ant Labs
posts.tagline: Small specialized AI models for speech, text, vision
posts.description: Desert Ant Labs builds small AI models that run on your phone or browser, no internet, no per-use cost. Instead of one big model doing everything, they make small ones, each nailing one task, across speech, text, and vision. Add any model in a few lines of code via one SDK. Free up to 100k monthly active devices.

posts.name: FreeScan.app
posts.tagline: Fix what’s hurting your visibility, trust, and conversions
posts.description: Audit any public URL for free, no signup. FreeScan uncovers problems and missed opportunities across SEO, AEO, GEO, security, accessibility, and design. Every finding includes evidence, why it matters, and how to fix it. Pro runs automated site-wide audits, organizes results into SEO, AI Visibility, and Fixes workspaces, tracks improvements and regressions, creates agent-ready artifacts, connects coding agents through MCP, monitors uptime, and sends weekly reports and downtime alerts.

posts.name: Modeinspect
posts.tagline: 99 Days Free AI Credits - Design product UI in your codebase
posts.description: Most software is designed twice: a picture first, then again in code. Intent drifts in between. Modeinspect is the AI design canvas for working on the real thing. Connect your codebase, open an existing screen, and design with your components, tokens, live data, states, and breakpoints. Explore with AI. Keep details that matter. When ready, publish your changes live or send them to engineering for review. You decide when they go live. The canvas is not the destination. The product is.

posts.name: Thousand
posts.tagline: Git-backed docs for humans and agents
posts.description: Git-backed docs with real access control, in one markdown repo with folder-level access where teammates, outsiders and AI agents each see exactly their folders.

posts.name: Viso Now
posts.tagline: Build computer vision applications with AI
posts.description: Viso Now is a self-building AI vision platform that turns images, video, and camera feeds into working computer vision applications. Describe what you want to understand, and Viso Now builds the agentic vision logic and custom live dashboards. All without model training, annotation, or writing code.

posts.name: Speechmark
posts.tagline: Private, on-device meeting notes for Mac
posts.description: Speechmark is a private macOS meeting-notes app. It records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings entirely on your Mac — decisions, action items, speaker-attributed transcripts. No bot joins the call, no account, one-time price. Integrates well with Claude Code using MCP server.

posts.name: Athenic AI
posts.tagline: Beat the market with 90+ datasets and AI made for analysis
posts.description: Find investment opportunities before everyone else does. Athenic provides $50,000 of licensed institutional stock data plus AI specialized for analysis. Screen for advanced filters in plain English, get alerted on news or price moves, and automate deep-dive fundamentals research.

posts.name: Whip
posts.tagline: Youtube for interactive web experiences
posts.description: Whip is a feed for the interactive expeirences. Discover and play games, 3D worlds, interactive stories, generative art, data visualizations, music toys, and more directly in your browser. Creators get channels, shareable pages, play counts, likes, and comments, so their work can build an audience instead of disappearing into a timeline.

posts.name: Wealthfolio
posts.tagline: Private, local-first personal finance
posts.description: Wealthfolio is an open-source personal finance app for tracking investments, net worth, spending and financial goals. Your financial data is stored locally and the core app works without an account or subscription. Use it on desktop, iPhone, iPad or self-host it. If you want less manual upkeep, Wealthfolio Connect adds automatic brokerage sync, end-to-end encrypted device sync and household sharing.

posts.name: Mock Magic: Video Presets
posts.tagline: Use saved presets to quickly get a branded device video
posts.description: Most mockup tools stop at images. Mock Magic turns a screen recording into a polished device video, in your brand colors, in the browser, in seconds. No Photoshop, no After Effects, nothing to install. Upload an image or video, pick a device (iPhone 17 Pro, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch and more), set a brand color with a hex code or add your own background, and download. Save your setup once and reuse it, so every mockup for your app store, website or socials matches.

posts.name: Vibe Eyes
posts.tagline: Put your pets in your macOS menu bar
posts.description: I miss my dog when I am at my desk all day. So now he lives in my menu bar. Drop in a photo and Vibe Eyes turns your own pet into a tiny animated avatar up there. It follows your cursor, blinks at you, winks when you click and looks up when you have been away. Small stuff, but you catch yourself glancing up and smiling. Eleven pets built in, free. Making your own is a $14.99 one-time unlock plus your own AI key. No subscription, no backend, your photo never touches my server.

posts.name: hob
posts.tagline: The professional workspace for your whole agent stack
posts.description: Run complex agent work while staying in control. hob brings multiple models and independent workflows into one professional workspace. Agents can shape the workspace around each task, coordinate through it, and guide you inside it. Run, review, automate, and recover agent work in the same system, so you can direct more parallel work without piecing together the infrastructure.

posts.name: Drive
posts.tagline: Vehicle telemetry for your next weekend drive with LPR alert
posts.description: I spent a few years as a design lead on autonomous driving for Android Auto, then spent my weekends in a 27-year-old car doing the exact opposite. Drive came out of that gap. It turns the phone already in your car into a telemetry rig — g-force, braking, cornering, the whole trace. It also flags license plate reader cameras as you approach them, since I like my privacy. No wiring loom. No dongle. No laptop. No sign up. Just driving fun.

posts.name: Gojo
posts.tagline: Local dictation and everyday Mac tools in your notch
posts.description: Gojo puts local dictation, clipboard history, window controls, a file shelf, and media controls in your MacBook notch. Download a speech model, then dictate into the field you're using. Recognition runs on your Mac in local mode. Includes calendar, battery, camera, and display controls. macOS 14+. Three-day trial; monthly and one-time licenses.

posts.name: HelixID
posts.tagline: Open-source identity & trust layer for AI agents
posts.description: HelixID is an open-source identity layer for AI agents. Most agent-auth tools stop at session-level access i.e. a token that gets an agent through one app, one time. HelixID goes further: every agent gets a W3C Verifiable Credential and DID, so its identity, authority, and actions can be proven across organizations, offline, and after the fact. Enforced with OPA/Rego, composes with your existing OAuth, self-hostable in 5 minutes. Apache 2.0, no vendor lock-in.

posts.name: ZOOMAA AI
posts.tagline: Generate thousands of leads on LinkedIn
posts.description: Zoomaa AI is within the category of LinkedIn tools, in it's own league. The AI model zoomaa-zebra1.0 is designed to make you money.

posts.name: geoSurge
posts.tagline: Free prompt tracking. Sign in with existing AI subscriptions
posts.description: We're democratising prompt tracking. Sign in with your existing ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini subscription, or bring your own key, and track how AI talks about your brand - for free. Discover where you get mentioned, who gets recommended instead, and what they get wrong.

posts.name: DreamFort
posts.tagline: Private Workspace for Uncensored AI
posts.description: Chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek, run an AI agent on your own device, and create images/videos in a private studio. DreamFort strips your identity from every request - no tracking, no logs tied to you.

posts.name: Truelist MCP
posts.tagline: Email validation for AI agents — hosted MCP, no keys
posts.description: A hosted MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, and Copilot real email superpowers: verify addresses, validate whole lists, create and query batches — in plain English. One URL, OAuth sign-in, no API keys to paste. Runs on the Truelist engine (1B+ emails validated).

posts.name: Wensity UI
posts.tagline: Production-ready React components for world-class interfaces
posts.description: Wensity UI is a premium library of production-ready React and Next.js components, blocks, interactions, and templates built for creating beautiful, polished web interfaces. From motion-rich components to complete UI blocks and templates, everything is crafted with thoughtful interactions, refined animations, and production-ready code. Build distinctive digital experiences faster without sacrificing quality, flexibility, or control over the details.

posts.name: systemscheck.dev
posts.tagline: A sci-fi systems check for your programming brain
posts.description: Lots of people will know of my obsession with programming puzzles. No longer content with just solving them, I decided to start creating and publishing my own. SystemsCheck is an engineering puzzle game set aboard the starship Orion. You play a cadet, handed alarming requests by a chief engineer with questionable delegation instincts. Solve each one by writing code against your own puzzle input. No set cadence, the puzzle corpus just keeps growing. Try it and let me know what you think!

posts.name: Web Anatomy
posts.tagline: AI design research for websites
posts.description: Our AI design research agent studies your competitors and market leaders to find relevant section examples for your website. See what makes each one effective and how to adapt it to your design.

posts.name: Trackee
posts.tagline: SEO & AI visibility, in one API.
posts.description: One API for tracking brand rankings, mentions, citations, and share of voice across Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity.

posts.name: (Cast)
posts.tagline: Audio-first podcast editor
posts.description: Cast is an audio-first podcast editor: edit by transcript, clean the voice, score the episode with generated music that ducks itself, and export with a commercial license.

posts.name: Nodeon
posts.tagline: Products, orders, stock & invoices in one synced hub
posts.description: Nodeon is a cloud ERP that unifies products, customers, orders, inventory and invoicing in one synced platform — no spreadsheets, no disconnected tools. Built for Italian SMEs: e-invoicing (SdI), DDT and fiscal compliance work out of the box. Onboarding is fast - you're online in 48 hours, not months. Modular: turn on only what you need and add more as you grow. Everything stays in sync in real time, from stock levels to issued invoices, so your team always works on the same data.

posts.name: Floating Notes 2.0
posts.tagline: Sticky notes on any webpage, synced across your devices
posts.description: Sticky notes that stay with the webpages you work on. V2 adds Google Drive sync across computers, custom URL rules, Markdown export, and 100,000-character notes with Pro. Free notes still work offline, with no account required.

posts.name: ResumeMaker.Online 2026
posts.tagline: The connected career toolkit built around your resume
posts.description: Build an ATS-friendly resume, tailor it to each role, improve your LinkedIn profile, track applications, and prepare for interviews in one connected workspace. Start without signing up and upgrade only when you need Pro tools or a professional PDF.

posts.name: Lucebra
posts.tagline: One platform to learn, teach, and grow
posts.description: Lucebra is an all-in-one, Learning Experience Platform (LXP) and Learning Management System (LMS) for enterprises, instructors, and individual learners. It brings online courses, certifications, mentoring, live learning, and corporate training together in one global platform with multilingual access, built-in monetization, analytics, and learning management tools.

posts.name: SubIQ
posts.tagline: SubIQ finds Service now fulfiller license drift
posts.description: Fulfiller licenses are consumed by activity, not by headcount. So the count drifts — quietly, for years — while the org chart stays the same. SubIQ finds fulfiller license drift — in custom tables, in inherited roles, and in seats nobody is using — before your renewal turns it into a negotiation.

posts.name: Custom Commands
posts.tagline: Build the Discord custom commands nobody else offers
posts.description: Your Discord server, your commands. Build slash and text commands, embeds, buttons, reaction roles and welcome cards, then give them the logic other bots can't do. Databases, jobs and events included. Nothing to host.

posts.name: Inkbound
posts.tagline: AI dictation + create your characters sheets automatically
posts.description: Inkbound is a browser-based writing app for novelists: chapters with characters and world-building in one place: a Codex. What's different: Inkbound's AI reads your manuscript and auto-extracts characters and world elements as you write, so your Codex builds itself. A built-in style assistant also flags repetitions and weak verbs in real time, fully client-side. + AI voice dictation. But No AI Writing. Free for one project. Premium for AI is a single $20 payment, never a subscription.

posts.name: Google Pics
posts.tagline: Workspace-native AI image create & edit
posts.description: Google Pics is Workspace-native AI image creation and editing, built on Nano Banana. Generate from a prompt or import from Drive/Photos, then refine with object-level edits, in-image text edit/translate, upscaling, and multi-gen options. Edit inline in Docs and Slides (Drive soon), and collaborate with shared links like the rest of Workspace. Try it at pics.new.

posts.name: Shortsly
posts.tagline: Turn your script into a short video you can edit
posts.description: Fix one scene without regenerating the whole video. Images, captions, and audio stay editable, so you can replace a visual, correct the text, or adjust the timing without moving to another tool. Combine your own photos and clips with AI-generated visuals, and reuse saved media and voiceovers across projects.

posts.name: HoodWars
posts.tagline: HoodWars  a parimutuel prediction market on Robinhood Chain.
posts.description: HoodWars is a platform for PvP token battles where users can stake USDG on various matchups like equities, memes, and global crypto. Participants enter battles based on their odds and winners take the pool from the losing side. The platform is designed for those interested in prediction-style betting and offers a unique way to engage with financial markets through token battles.

posts.name: HobbyCue
posts.tagline: Your Hobby, Your Community
posts.description: You can now Bookmark anything, receive Notifications, view your Activity Log, Buy Now from Amazon, Add to Cart and Pay through UPI in India. Automated Spam Controls with Admin actions on Posts, Pages and Users. Approval workflow for new Hobbies, Page Claims, Blogs. Get Support on your content with Ticket tracking or Report an issue on others' content.

posts.name: Conseleo
posts.tagline: Board intelligence in a vault that's yours.
posts.description: Coming soon! Conseleo is a board intelligence software for boards and individual directors. Your board pack sits in a vault that is yours. We can’t access it. Ask it anything. Every answer cited to a page you can open and check. It answers from your pack, or it tells you it cannot. No answer is better than a confident guess. Early access now. Live November 2026.

posts.name: DungeonOne
posts.tagline: The endless joy of solo tabletop RPGs
posts.description: Love tabletop RPGs, but can't find a group or time to play? DungeonOne is your personal AI-powered Game Master. Experience a full-featured fantasy TTRPG solo — anytime, anywhere, with no scheduling required! Whether you want to dive into ready-made sagas or explore infinite open-world sandboxes, an adaptive AI Game Master handles combat, adjudicates d20 mechanics, controls NPCs, and weaves a unique narrative around your choices.

posts.name: Sketchar Multiplayer for Meta Quest
posts.tagline: Paint Murals Together using AR/VR
posts.description: Sketchar launches the first multiplayer mural painting feature for Meta Quest — several headsets now see the same sketch, in the same place, on the same wall. Mural teams, schools, and live events can finally paint together.

posts.name: Worldesk AI FX Dealer
posts.tagline: AI FX Dealer for businesses making cross-border payments.
posts.description: We've been in the global payments business for many years, providing institutional-level FX service and solutions to companies making cross-border payments. We've now taken that experience and built Worldesk AI - an AI FX Dealer specifically for businesses. Ask it anything about rates, timing, or hedging. Price an upcoming payment, or check what your bank really charged you on a past conversion. 13 AI advisors give you a clear act-now, wait, or hedge recommendation. No login required.

posts.name: Doodlyo
posts.tagline: Turn any text or URL into a ready-to-share doodle visual
posts.description: Turn your ideas into scroll-stopping visuals — without designing from scratch. Just paste your text or a URL. Doodlyo understands the key message and transforms it into a unique doodle-style social visual with a matching caption, ready to share in seconds. Perfect for founders, marketers, and creators who have something worth saying but don’t want to spend hours designing it.

posts.name: Brightney
posts.tagline: Your work, finally connected.
posts.description: Brightney is an AI workspace that connects your company’s knowledge, tools, meetings, and workflows in one place. Search across scattered information, ask questions with full business context, run AI agents, and automate work without switching between apps.

posts.name: Wallos
posts.tagline: Every subscription you forgot about, on a server you own
posts.description: A self-hosted subscription tracker. You add what you pay for and it shows the real recurring total across every currency and billing cycle, including the annual plans that charge once a year and are the ones people forget they are still on. Runs in one Docker container on hardware you own, so nobody else holds a list of everything you subscribe to. Categories, payment methods, per-member tracking for a household, budgets, and a notice before a renewal hits. GPL-3.0.

posts.name: Ozor
posts.tagline: Convert any document into training videos in minutes
posts.description: Ozor turns the documents companies already have (SOPs, manuals, policies, onboarding decks) into branded training videos with voiceover in minutes. Ozor 2.0 adds a team of agents that plan, script, design and edit each video, plus chat editing so L&D and ops teams can fix a scene without touching a timeline. Brand Kit keeps every video consistent across departments. Through the API, the n8n node or the MCP server, videos can be generated automatically whenever a document changes.

posts.name: Tend
posts.tagline: A private behavior journal for autism parents
posts.description: Tend is a private iPhone behavior journal for parents of autistic and neurodivergent children. Quickly log meltdowns, behaviors, sensory triggers, incidents, medications and meaningful changes, then keep a clear history for therapy, medical, school and IEP conversations.

posts.name: BackiGo
posts.tagline: True iCloud Photos & Drive backup for Mac, iPhone & iPad
posts.description: iCloud is sync, NOT a backup—delete on iPhone, iPad, or Mac, and it vanishes everywhere. BackiGo delivers true backup & 1-click lossless restore. Back up to external drives, NAS, or cloud storage. Restore original-quality photos, Live Photos, RAW files, and albums to Apple Photos. Schedule automatic backups with optional AES-256 encryption. Available on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, with Apple Family Sharing.

posts.name: Rotebete
posts.tagline: Learn German from your everyday life.
posts.description: Rotebete is an adaptive German learning platform powered by AI agents. Share a photo, voice note, or text from your everyday life, and Rotebete turns it into a personalized lesson. Our agents understand what you already know, identify your weaknesses, and build a learning plan around what you need to improve next. Instead of following the same fixed course as everyone else, every learner gets a continuously evolving path designed around their real life, level, and goals.

posts.name: ClawEase 2.0
posts.tagline: AI receptionist that gets work done in your web systems
posts.description: ClawEase 2.0 brings AI reception into the web systems your team already uses. Explore a process, turn it into an inspectable skill, test it with realistic customer conversations, and connect it to Phone, Email, WebChat, WhatsApp, or custom channels. Follow conversations and business actions in real time, with human handoff whenever needed.

posts.name: isthereanytool.app
posts.tagline: The directory of hidden design, craft & AI tools
posts.description: Most tool directories are SEO dumps. This one is curated shelves of design, craft, and AI tools that are actually worth opening, grouped so you can find something in under a minute. What stands out: • 1700+ tools across 40+ categories (image gen, design systems, MCP, coding agents, OG images, and more) • Search that stays on the shelf instead of dumping you into noise • Sponsor slots on every page if you want to put a product in front of builders who are already shopping for tools

posts.name: Clero
posts.tagline: Pay, Request, Split
posts.description: Send and receive money directly between bank accounts with same-day settlement and zero transfer fees-no digital wallet needed. Clero combines direct bank payments, card transaction splitting via Plaid, receipt scanning, and group expense tracking into one app. • Fee-free direct transfers: Settle straight to bank accounts. • Smart splitting: Auto-detect subscriptions and scan receipts. • Group tracking: Roommate cycles, trip pools, and debt simplification.

posts.name: Tributly-Turn AI waiting time into money
posts.tagline: Get paid for seeing ads.
posts.description: Tributly turns everyday digital attention into value. See small, non-intrusive ads while browsing - and soon during natural waiting moments while AI generates a response - and earn up to 50% of the ad revenue. No surveys, no extra tasks: just use the web as usual. Our goal is simple: let advertising help offset the cost of the AI tools and digital subscriptions you already use.

posts.name: FastPubSub
posts.tagline: Global low-latency pub/sub infra for real-time apps
posts.description: FastPubSub helps real-time apps deliver messages faster and more consistently across regions. Instead of relying on default Internet routing, it continuously measures path quality between relays and routes traffic around congestion and suboptimal paths. The result is a lightweight global pub/sub layer for live events, fan-out delivery, multiplayer games, and other latency-sensitive workloads. You can also try a few simple live demos to see FastPubSub in action: https://demo.fastpubsub.com/

posts.name: Farol App
posts.tagline: Your Git worktrees, one click away in your Mac menu bar
posts.description: Farol brings your worktrees to your Mac’s menu bar. Open each in your preferred IDE or terminal, and automate setup and cleanup with per-project scripts. Built for developers juggling projects and parallel AI coding agents.

posts.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
posts.tagline: Multimodal AI for coding and agents, with 1M context
posts.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash combines text and image understanding with a 1M-token context window and up to 384K output tokens. Build coding assistants and AI agents using tool calling, JSON output, and OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Available now as deepseek-flash, with usage-based, peak/off-peak pricing.

posts.name: ZoInvoice
posts.tagline: Invoicing that feels effortless.
posts.description: Create, send and track invoices in any currency. Flexible taxes, multi-currency, server-rendered PDFs and effortless payments.

posts.name: Nakxi
posts.tagline: AI App Store Optimization Platform for Mobile Apps
posts.description: Creating a great app listing shouldn't require five different tools. Nakxi is an AI App Store Optimization Platform that helps you design App Store & Google Play screenshots, generate AI-powered metadata, research keywords, analyze competitors and reviews, optimize visual ASO, localize screenshots and listings, and publish directly to App Store Connect and Google Play—all from one workspace.

posts.name: CCC
posts.tagline: Your coding agents outgrew your terminal. One local board.
posts.description: CCC puts every Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi Code, OpenCode, and Devin session on one place and lets you build workers to run them autonomously Spawn sessions, steer any of them with follow-ups, queue work through Watchtower, and let it run unattended. I use it to fix customer reports overnight: an auditor files GitHub issues, CCC works the queue, I only approve go/no-go. Runs on your machine, stdlib Python, no cloud. Free for personal use, source on GitHub.

posts.name: Estante - Stores for LATAM
posts.tagline: Launch your online store in minutes
posts.description: Estante is the simplest way to launch an online store in Latin America. No code, no hidden fees: build your catalog, connect MercadoPago or dLocal, and start selling in minutes. Unlike platforms built for the US/Europe, Estante is designed around how people actually get paid in LATAM: MercadoPago, recurring subscriptions, and local checkout flows. Perfect for entrepreneurs selling digital or physical products who want something light, fast, and frictionless.

posts.name: StartupSurfers - Surf Game for Founders
posts.tagline: Ride. Trick. Promote.
posts.description: A free pixel-art surf game for founders. Ride the wave, land tricks and climb a global leaderboard — then start a league and race your crew every 28-day season.

posts.name: FitGate
posts.tagline: Turn your AI agent's approval prompts into micro-workouts
posts.description: FitGate intercepts the moment your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf...) stops to ask "Do you want to proceed?" — and gates that approval behind a 10-second-to-2-minute micro-workout: push-ups, squats, a stretch, a 20-20-20 eye rest. You were about to sit and wait anyway. Now the wait makes you healthier. Free, open source (AGPL-3.0), runs offline forever, no account needed.

posts.name: Runnable
posts.tagline: An independent Actions-compatible CI control plane
posts.description: Runnable is an independent CI control plane that runs GitHub Actions-compatible workflows without relying on the Actions scheduler or runner infrastructure. Keep GitHub as your source of truth, migrate existing workflows with a safe parallel pilot, or run CI for Entire mirrors and Entire-native repositories. Get compatibility checks, isolated Linux runners, matrix builds, reusable workflows, caches, artifacts, approvals, concurrency, retries, and masked logs.

posts.name: Upvera
posts.tagline: The progress network for people who build.
posts.description: Upvera is a social network for founders and builders to make progress visible from day one. Create projects, share updates and milestones, discover promising products early, and support them with UPV. Unlike a static like, UPV support can rise or fall with a project’s progress over time. Upvera turns discovery into something active: find great products before everyone else does, follow their journey, and become part of what they build. Here, the product itself becomes the social object.

posts.name: DrawDog
posts.tagline: Prove a Human Made It, Not a Prompt
posts.description: Clients are starting to ask freelancers to prove their work wasn't generated. DrawDog sits in your menu bar and records how your file grew, what apps were in front of you, and whether an AI tool was ever open. It signs and timestamps that record, then gives you one link to send. The client drags your file onto the page to confirm it's the one you certified. It never looks inside your work: no screen recording, no keystrokes, no file names. Three certificates a month, free.

posts.name: agent-harness
posts.tagline: The missing package manager for MCP servers and AI skills
posts.description: Stop managing AI agent assets by hand. agent-harness discovers MCP servers, skills, and rules from trusted sources; pins and mirrors them reproducibly; quarantines risky inputs; then wires everything into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Zed, Codex and Pi.

posts.name: omadesign
posts.tagline: Native Linux studio for design, paint, photo & motion
posts.description: omadesign is an open-source (MIT) native Linux studio for designers who left macOS — or never had a clean Affinity/Illustrator-shaped seat on Linux. Design, Pixel, Photo, and Motion share one document and layer stack. v0.0.4-alpha. Built to sit down and make work, not babysit Electron.

posts.name: mactap
posts.tagline: Knock your MacBook to run shortcuts
posts.description: MacTap is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that turns knocks on your MacBook chassis into shortcuts. One, two, or three knocks copy, paste, accept an AI suggestion, take a screenshot, control media, or anything you map. It reads the accelerometer inside the unibody (the same sensor that detects if your laptop is falling) and classifies knocks on-device. Nothing gets uploaded, no account, no network calls. Just a small native Swift app sitting in your menu bar.

posts.name: Jotted
posts.tagline: Record any meeting. No bot in the call, no account to start.
posts.description: Jotted records Zoom, Teams and Google Meet calls without a bot ever joining the meeting. Most bot-free tools throw the recording away — Jotted keeps the full video, plus a transcript, summary and action items. Free forever, and it works with no account at all: download it, open it, and record. Windows only for now. Built solo in the Philippines because every other bot-free tool is Mac-first and none of them keep the video.

posts.name: Agent Civilizations
